LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_Settings_RestartHint: Content pack state is decided before defs load, so changes only apply after a restart. Disabling a pack removes its content from saves that contain it the next time those saves are loaded.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_Settings_SaveHint: Each save keeps a snapshot of the packs it was saved with; loading it after a change reports the difference in the message log.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal.Pack.Weapons.Label: Weapons - mechanoid salvage launchers
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal.Pack.Weapons.Description: Five bullpup and shoulder-fired launchers built from salvaged mechanoid parts, firing the same heavy ammunition the mechanoids use.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal.Pack.Medical.Label: Medical - biofoam
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal.Pack.Medical.Description: A belt-mounted biofoam injector that spends a charge to seal the worst bleeding wound once the wearer starts bleeding out.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_Biofoam_Triggered: {0}: biofoam injector sealed the worst wound ({1}). Charges left {2}/{3}.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_Biofoam_RechargeDesc: Consume 1 medicine to restore {0} charges. If the medicine is not carried, the wearer walks to it first, then spends a moment reloading.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_Biofoam_CannotStart: {0} cannot start reloading the biofoam injector right now.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_PackChange_Disabled: Content pack(s) disabled since this save was created: {0}. Their content is no longer loaded.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_PackChange_Enabled: Content pack(s) enabled since this save was created: {0}.
LanguageData.LatiosArsenal_LobMode_Desc: Lob mode: the shell arcs over obstacles. Muzzle velocity is lower, warmup and cooldown are multiplied by 1.5, and spread is multiplied by 1.5. Use it to hit targets behind walls and cover.
